name: quioteframework/cloud-azure
description: Minimal Azure Blob and Table Storage clients for Quiote — SharedKey-signed REST access with no azure-sdk dependency. Shared by the Azure session and filesystem backends.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/cloud-azure/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
